title: Envelope lettering transferred onto developed X-ray film

tellings.quote: about 200 other X-rays. and um he showed it to me and the lettering from the outside of the envelope that the X-ray was in had somehow been transferred to the developed X-ray film.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects people believe are alien implants in their bodies, says a doctor he names as Dr. builder once showed him one X-ray out of about 200. On it, he says, the lettering from the outside of the envelope that held the X-ray had somehow been transferred onto the developed film. Colbern tells it as something he saw with his own eyes, a sign that something unusual had been acting on the film.
